meta.source: BLAZE CAMP MASTER MODEL (raw/MASTER_MODEL.xlsx) tabs 'EXAMPLE CROSSFIT SPLIT', '(NOT DONE) 4 TRACKS PROGRAMMING', '(NOT DONE) EXAMPLE CONJUGATE'
meta.counting_convention: 1 working set = 1.0 to each prime mover, 0.5 to each clear synergist; prime movers = BYOP MASTER EXERCISE LIBRARY row-6 PURPOSE labels (OBSERVED), synergists INFERRED. Athletic (AP_*) sets are reported as athletic_exposure, never added to hypertrophy volume. Conditioning (aerobic, sprints, WODs) counted as sessions/bouts, not sets.
meta.rep_notation: date cells with number_format m/d are text the coach typed: '8/8' = 8 reps per side (C12/C16 in tab 04, C16/C20 in tab 12); '1/1'...'4/4' in CrossFit S4:S10 = strength level / power level codes

non_canonical_keys.RES_LB_UNSPEC/RES_UB_UNSPEC: CrossFit 'RESISTANCE' LB/UB slot with no exercise named (1 exercise assumed per slot as written)
non_canonical_keys.SKILL_sessions: 'T2B/ DUBS', 'H.S./ DUBS', 'DUBS', 'GYMNASTICS' (T2B -> CP_CORE_PELVIS, DUBS -> AP_JUMP_LIMITED_KNEE, H.S. -> handstand skill, INFERRED)

open_questions: FULL TIME vs HALF TIME (CROSSFIT A19 / Q19): is FULL TIME the full-time competitor's dosing and HALF TIME the class / part-time member's dosing? I read it that way because only HALF TIME has 'LVL 5 = Work up to 1RM' and the class cycle ends in '5'. Or does HALF TIME mean a quality trained alongside another one?
Class cycle S4:S11 shows '1/1','2/1','2/2','3/2','3/3','4/3','4/4','5' (Sheets stored them as dates). Is that 'strength level / power level' for weeks 1-8, with strength leading by one week?
'LVL 4 = wods a week' has no number. Is it 4? Also AUG is WODs level 3 ('3 wods a week') but the AUGUST grid has only TUESD/FRID marked. Which is right?

MARCH lists STRENGTH (KNEE DOM/PULL/HIP DOM/PUSH) and POWER (SNATCH/CLEAN) days, and APRIL lists RESISTANCE (LB/UB), but the macro gives them no level. Should they be trained, and at what level, or are they leftovers?

CrossFit RESISTANCE 'LB'/'UB': how many exercises per session, and which patterns (unilateral + isolation like 'the nuance'/'the survival')? The same question applies to 'ACCESSORIES' (AESTHETICS-8) and 'UPPER ACCESORY'/'LOWER ACCESORY' (HYBRID).
CrossFit strength 'PULL' and 'PUSH' days: vertical, horizontal, or alternating? The class split says 'PRESS'. Does that mean strict overhead press?
Load words in the conjugate cycle: is 'MAX' = the heaviest load for the prescribed reps at about 0-1 RIR, 'ALL' = all-out / to failure, and 'EASY' (plyos) = sub-maximal height and effort?
Green SETS ladder E4:L4 (5,5,4,4,3,3,2,1) in 4 TRACKS: does it apply only to the M.E. rows (B9/B13 = 5), or also to the plyo (B17 = 3) and D.E. bench (B21 = 3) rows that share the green fill?
STRENGTH-12 'the accessory' has no sets/reps. What dose (e.g. 3x6-8 @ 2RIR as in the 8-week version)? Do the Thursday/Saturday 'FAST RPE6 or about 60-70%' rows use the header SETS/REPS?

Unilateral pairing rule: STRENGTH-8 pairs lunges with squat weeks (same dominance), but STRENGTH-12 and HYBRID pair them with the opposite dominance (squat -> staggered DL / uni RDL). Which is your rule, or does it depend on the goal?

AESTHETICS-12 reps such as '12/10/8 -20' or '8/8/8-12': is the '-20' an extra burn-out/back-off set, or the rep target for isolation (small-muscle) exercises? Weeks 4-6 say SETS 4 but list only three numbers before the dash.

HYBRID: what does the 'AMRAP' row (12,15,16,...,20) apply to? I read it as minutes for the Saturday lunge/T2B/push-pull circuit. What are the unlabeled rows 78 (2,2,2,3,3,3,4,4) and 79 (2,2,3,2,2,3,2,2)?
HYBRID lists STRENGTH before OLY/POWER on Monday/Thursday. Is the heavy lift really done before the Olympic lift? And is C86 'KD' on the deadlift row a typo for HD?
The tab is named '4 TRACKS' but A1 says '8 WEEKS OF 3 TRACKS'. What is the 4th track (CrossFit / athletic)? Is the right-hand 12-week block the newer version of each track?
Definitions: is 'the nuance' = unilateral / variation / weak-point work and 'the survival' = isolation / joint-health / pump work that must be done no matter what?
None of these three tabs programs calves, and side/rear delts get under 5 sets/week outside AESTHETICS-12. Is that intentional (covered by FOCUS / accessories) or a gap the generator should fill?

Is the 12-week shape (6 loading weeks + week-7 deload + 5 weeks with a phase change) the template for every 12-week plan? Should a 6-week plan be the first 6 weeks, ending at the highlighted WK6 peak?

Fills: what do FCE5CD peach on weeks 1-5 of the STRENGTH 8-week block, FFF2CC on WK6 and 00FF00 on 'LOW BAR' in the 12-week block, and the cyan 'TEST' at J3 above WK6 in the conjugate tab mean? Are they progress markers or a planned week-6 test?
'30-40 mi slow/steady CARDIO': does 'mi' mean minutes? Is that the 'C' aerobic type from the cheat sheet?

programs.title: 'COMPETE CROSSFIT SPLIT' / 'EXAMPLE PLAN BUILDING FOR WODAPALOOZA' / 'EVENT DATE JAN 12-15th'
programs.goal: Competitive CrossFit athlete peaking for an event (Wodapalooza, JAN 12-15); every modality trained ('you MUST be able to be as good as possible in EACH modality')
programs.level: Quality levels 1-4 per month (macro grid); FULL TIME dosing table
programs.days_per_week: 4 core days MON/TUE/THU/FRI (+SAT used for extra AEROBIC/WOD in level-3/4 months; WED and SUN = 'OFF' in every month)
programs.exercises_per_session_note: count of programmed COMPONENTS per day (AEROBIC, SKILL, STRENGTH, POWER, RESISTANCE, WOD), order MON..SUN; RESISTANCE counted as 1 component

level_tables.AEROBIC_letters: from 'AEROBIC CAPACITY CHEAT SHEET': A = 'Short Duration'/'High Intensity' (blue A4C2F4), B = 'Moderate Duration'/'Moderate Intensity' (green B6D7A8), C = 'Long Duration'/'Low intensity' (orange F9CB9C); 'LACTATE CLEARANCE' = its own interval table

rep_ranges_by_bucket.AP_TRIPLE_EXT: 3 reps at every FULL TIME level (HALF TIME 4/3/2/1)

programs.intensity: No %/RPE in tab; A4 '*INSTEAD OF WORKING TO FAILURE, PUSH YOUR LIMITS OVER THE COURSE OF TIME'
programs.progression_summary: Month-to-month level steps. FULL TIME strength sets/slot 3->4->5->6 (+33%, +25%, +20%) while reps 7->6->5->4, so total reps/slot stay 21-25; power sets 3->4->5->6 at 3 reps (total reps 9->12->15->18, +33/+25/+20%); resistance 2x10 -> 3x10 (+50%); aerobic adds one intensity zone per level (C -> C,B -> C,B,A -> lactate clearance) and sessions 2->2->3->4; WODs 1->2->3->4 per week. Annual shape = three ~4-month blocks each ending in TEST/PEAK (MAY, SEPT, JAN event): hypertrophy (RESISTANCE) -> STRENGTH -> POWER -> peak, with conditioning (AEROBIC C., WODs) climbing level 1/2 -> 4 inside each block and resetting at the next block. Weekly lifting sets as written: FEB 8, MAR 12, APR 28, MAY 0, JUN 28, JUL 36, AUG 20, SEP 24, OCT 24, NOV 28, DEC 20, JAN 0.

programs.progression_summary: Wave 1 (wk1-6): sets 4,4,5,5,6,6 x reps 5,5,4,4,3,3 @ 80->90% / RPE 7->9 (work reps/session 20,20,20,20,18,18 = volume held, intensity +5% every 2 weeks); wk7 'MID DELOAD' 3x4 @ RPE 7 (-33% work reps); wave 2 (wk8-12): 5x4, 6x3, 6x3, 7x2, 7x2 @ RPE 8,9,9,9,10 (work reps 20,18,18,14,14). Work sets/week 16->24 then 12 then 20->28; compounding ~+5.2%/week wk1->wk12 (4->7 sets). Accessory/nuance/survival fixed. A/B weeks alternate squat-main vs hinge-main.

programs.title: 'HYBRID' / 'strenght - athletic - crossfitish training' rows 69-101 (WK1-WK8)
programs.days_per_week: 5 (MON, TUE, THU, FRI, SAT; WED/SUN off - INFERRED from absence)
programs.assumptions: header SETS/REPS (D71:L72) apply to the three STRENGTH rows; row-78 numbers 2,2,2,3,3,3,4,4 = sets for Monday 'UPPER ACCESORY'/'HOR PULL'; tri-set components unset (assumed = header sets); jumps unset (assumed 3 sets x 6 'EASY' borrowed from STRENGTH track plyo row); Tue/Thu/Fri accessory rows unset (assumed row-78 sets, counted as FOCUS); Saturday circuit = AMRAP (minutes, inferred) - assumed rounds = header sets
programs.intensity: Oly 'heavy'; sprints 'fast'/'fastest' in wk7-8; Friday cardio 'easy'; no RIR written
programs.progression_summary: 3-week micro-waves: reps 6->8->10 at constant sets, then +1 set and reset reps (sets 2,2,2,3,3,3,4,4): strength reps/exercise 12,16,20,18,24,30,24,32 (+15%/week compounding wk1->wk8). AMRAP 12,15,16,17,18,19,20,20 (min, +1/week after wk2). Sprints: bouts 10->12->15 per block, work 15s->20s->30s, rest 1:2 -> 1:4; total work 150,180,225,200,240,300,150,300 s. Bench: 3x6, 3x6, 3x8, 3x8, 3x10, 3x10, 4x6, 4x8 alternating flat/incline. Jumps: depth drops -> weighted depth drops -> depth drop to jump -> weighted depth drop to jump -> box jumps -> repeat hurdle hops (amplitude/complexity ladder).
